concern_summary: This concern captures the functionality of the split button, which allows users to initiate split actions and access additional options through a dropdown interface.
Management of chat reports related to split transactions, ensuring proper recording and communication.
Creation and updating of chat reports based on participant actions and split transactions.
This concern involves the initiation of a group chat split request by validating necessary parameters and retrieving the appropriate draft workspace through an API call.

The functions collectively manage the processing and storage of group chat split requests, handling the persistence of requests and the adjustments to their statuses as they move through various administrative states.

This concern focuses on the validation and management of the Merchant Name within the context of a group chat split request, ensuring that it is properly handled during the creation or editing of transactions.
Management of expenses and transactions within the context of chat reports linked to group chats.

This concern deals specifically with the creation and management of requests for splitting expenses among participants, encapsulating transaction generation and report handling linked to expense splitting.
This concern covers the management of scan requests, ensuring that the appropriate context and classification are evaluated for transactions deemed as scan requests.
